description: Fix 3D PnL graph issues: swap axis mapping (PnL=Y, OI=Z), fix zero-plane orientation, cap PnL for closed trades.
steps: Swap axis mapping in PnlGraph3D.tsx so PnL is Y (vertical/up) and OI is Z (depth)
Fix the zero-PnL plane to be horizontal at y = normalize(0, pnlRange) with no rotation
Cap PnL calculation for closed trades: filter dates to <= closed_at, or use buy_close/sell_close for post-close dates
Update axis labels and subtitle to reflect the new mapping
Verify tsc -b and vite build pass
acceptance_criteria: PnL is on the Y-axis (vertical/up in Three.js)
OI is on the Z-axis (depth in Three.js)
Zero-PnL plane is horizontal at the correct Y position
Closed trades do not show PnL movements after closed_at
vite build produces a bundle without errors
